articles.title: Loose Papers Without Supporting Evidence Cannot Sustain Brokerage Additions: ITAT Ahmedabad
articles.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) Ahmedabad deleted estimated brokerage additions made by tax authorities because they relied only on loose papers and inquiry registers without corroborative evidence. Core inflation is expected to stay around 4%, indicating that underlying price pressures remain stable.
